tools.name: purchase_workspace_seats
tools.description: Buys additional paid member seats for a team chat workspace by charging the workspace's card on file through Stripe. Records the purchase in the workspace billing ledger.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: ID of the workspace to add seats to

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import time

import stripe

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_workspace_billing"

DB_PATH = "/var/data/workspace.db"


def purchase_workspace_seats(workspace_id: str, seat_count: int, price_per_seat_cents: int) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT stripe_customer_id, stripe_payment_method FROM workspace_billing WHERE workspace_id = ?",
        (workspace_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    total_cents = seat_count * price_per_seat_cents
    idempotency_key = f"seats-{workspace_id}-{seat_count}-{int(time.time() // 60)}"
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=total_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=row["stripe_customer_id"],
        payment_method=row["stripe_payment_method"],
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"{seat_count} additional seats for workspace {workspace_id}",
        metadata={"workspace_id": workspace_id, "seats": str(seat_count)},
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO billing_ledger (workspace_id, kind, amount_cents, stripe_id, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (workspace_id, "seat_purchase", total_cents, intent.id, int(time.time())),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {
        "payment_intent": intent.id,
        "status": intent.status,
        "seats": seat_count,
        "total_cents": total_cents,
    }

tools.name: run_workspace_export_report
tools.description: Looks up a workspace's message volume per channel in the chat database, then runs the local report generator script to build a usage report file from those numbers.

params.name: days
params.description: Number of past days to include

params.name: output_dir
params.description: Directory where the report is written

tools.code:
import json
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

from langchain.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "/var/data/chat.db"
REPORT_SCRIPT = "/opt/chat/scripts/generate_usage_report.py"


@tool
def run_workspace_export_report(workspace_id: str, days: int, output_dir: str) -> str:
    cutoff = int(time.time()) - days * 86400
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT c.name, COUNT(m.id) FROM channels c LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.channel_id = c.id AND m.created_at >= ? WHERE c.workspace_id = ? GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY COUNT(m.id) DESC",
        (cutoff, workspace_id),
    ).fetchall()
    conn.close()
    stats = [{"channel": name, "messages": count} for name, count in rows]
    out_path = Path(output_dir) / f"usage_{workspace_id}_{days}d.html"
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["python3", REPORT_SCRIPT, "--workspace", workspace_id, "--output", str(out_path)],
        input=json.dumps(stats),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    summary = result.stdout.strip()
    return f"exit={result.returncode} channels={len(stats)} output={out_path}\n{summary}"
